subject.title: feat(nodes): route alerts to the active computer

question: Should active-computer identity, model prompt projection, and Gateway-owned node-connection alert routing become the permanent product contract?
rationale: This feature adds protocol, Gateway, CLI, model-context, native-app, and notification-ownership behavior across stable surfaces; the linked issue and protected label already signal unresolved maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the full contract
options.body: Keep the architecture after all delivery defects are fixed and signed two-Mac behavior is proven.

options.title: Narrow observability first
options.body: Land active-node API and CLI visibility but defer prompt projection or alert routing for separate approval.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Retain current per-Mac notifications until maintainers sponsor a different active-computer contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full contract
recommendation.body: Keep the architecture after all delivery defects are fixed and signed two-Mac behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned and has the strongest merged-history connection across all central surfaces.
